//.about: Order Management System — AWS serverless POC built with CDK (TypeScript). See PLAN.md for the full phased architecture.

scripts.build: Compiles CDK infra code (lib/, bin/) via tsc. Lambda handler code (src/) is NOT compiled here — it's bundled by esbuild at deploy time via NodejsFunction.
scripts.watch: Same as build but re-compiles on file changes. Useful during CDK development.
scripts.test: Runs Jest test suites (CDK assertion tests in test/infra/, handler unit tests in test/unit/).
scripts.cdk: Shortcut to run CDK CLI commands, e.g. `pnpm cdk synth`, `pnpm cdk deploy`.

dependencies.@aws-lambda-powertools/commons + logger: Structured logging with correlation IDs, cold start detection, and JSON output. commons is the shared base required by all Powertools packages. Both MUST be pinned to the same version — a mismatch breaks esbuild ESM resolution.
dependencies.@aws-sdk/client-dynamodb + lib-dynamodb: DynamoDB Document Client for Lambda handlers. Externalized from esbuild bundles (externalModules: ['@aws-sdk/*']) because Lambda's Node.js 20 runtime already ships AWS SDK v3.
dependencies.aws-cdk-lib + constructs: CDK v2 core library and construct base. Used in lib/stacks/ to define all AWS infrastructure. NOT bundled into Lambdas — only used at synth/deploy time.
dependencies.uuid: Generates UUIDs for orderId, paymentId. Used in Lambda handlers at runtime.
dependencies.zod: Runtime input validation in Lambda handlers. Validates business rules that API Gateway JSON Schema models can't express (e.g. status transitions, quantity > 0).

devDependencies.@types/*: TypeScript type definitions. @types/aws-lambda provides APIGatewayProxyEvent/Result types for handler signatures.
devDependencies.aws-cdk: CDK CLI tool. Runs cdk synth, cdk deploy, cdk destroy. Separate from aws-cdk-lib (the library).
devDependencies.esbuild: JavaScript bundler used by CDK's NodejsFunction to compile and tree-shake each Lambda's TypeScript into a single minified JS file. Its postinstall script must be approved in pnpm-workspace.yaml (pnpm v11 supply-chain security).
devDependencies.jest + ts-jest: Test runner for CDK assertion tests and handler unit tests. ts-jest lets Jest run TypeScript directly without a separate compile step.
devDependencies.ts-node: Runs TypeScript directly in Node.js. Required by CDK CLI — cdk.json uses 'npx ts-node' to execute bin/app.ts without compiling first.
devDependencies.typescript: TypeScript compiler. Used by the 'build' script to compile CDK infra code (lib/, bin/) and by ts-jest for tests.
